parties.petitioner: Pathapati Subba Reddy (Died) By Lrs And ...

summary: Land acquisition reference dismissal appeal; delay of 5659 days; heirs failed to substitute deceased claimants; single family pursued appeal after 15+ years; High Court rejected condonation; Supreme Court affirms strict limitation application; sufficient cause not established; public policy favours finality over belated claims; appeal barred despite liberal interpretation of Section 5; mandatory dismissal under Section 3 upheld.
final_judgment: Special Leave Petition dismissed; High Court decision affirmed; appeal barred by limitation.
